description: No discharge antibiotic prescribed to complete the pneumonia treatment course despite severe infection at admission.
evidence_in_history: Visit 1 plan includes starting Azithromycin 500 mg once daily for 5 days for pneumonia.
evidence_in_summary: Azithromycin listed as 'Not prescribed at discharge' with note about no discharge antibiotic prescribed to complete treatment.
suggested_correction: Document continuation or completion plan for antibiotic treatment at discharge, prescribe appropriate antibiotic therapy to complete pneumonia treatment.

description: No documentation of corticosteroid use or consideration despite COPD exacerbation severity during hospitalization.
evidence_in_history: Assessment of acute bacterial pneumonia on background of COPD exacerbation, plan addresses antibiotics and inhalers but no steroids mentioned.
evidence_in_summary: Hospital course notes absence of corticosteroid use for COPD exacerbation.
suggested_correction: Document rationale for corticosteroid use or omission in management of COPD exacerbation; consider appropriate corticosteroid therapy if indicated.

description: No explicit documentation of allergy review during admission or consideration of antibiotic choice and cross-reactivity given penicillin and sulfa drug allergies.
evidence_in_history: Allergy record lists penicillin and sulfa drug allergies, but antibiotic plan uses Azithromycin without allergy review.
evidence_in_summary: Hospital course states allergy review not documented, no rationale for antibiotic choice in context of allergies.
suggested_correction: Include allergy review and document antibiotic selection rationale; address cross-reactivity risks and alternative antibiotic options if needed.

description: Vital signs such as peak temperature and respiratory rates during hospitalization were not documented; pulmonary function monitoring was limited.
evidence_in_history: Objective data collected during outpatient visit and labs noted but no continuous monitoring information during admission.
evidence_in_summary: Hospital course mentions intermittent vital signs recording with missing peak temperature and respiratory rate details and limited respiratory monitoring.
suggested_correction: Provide daily or more frequent vital signs documentation and pulmonary function monitoring details during hospitalization to assess patient status accurately.

description: No documentation of patient education or instructions related to oxygen use, warning signs, or management of COPD exacerbation at discharge.
evidence_in_history: Plan includes patient education on infection and COPD exacerbation symptoms but no specific oxygen or warning sign instructions.
evidence_in_summary: Hospital course states discharge education provided but no documentation of oxygen use instructions or clear return-to-hospital criteria; follow-up appointments recommended but not scheduled or fully documented.
suggested_correction: Document detailed patient education on oxygen therapy, signs/symptoms requiring urgent care, and ensure follow-up appointments are scheduled and communicated.

description: No documented plan for repeat chest imaging or pulmonary function testing post-discharge to monitor resolution of pneumonia and COPD status.
evidence_in_history: Spirometry performed in outpatient visit shows COPD moderate obstruction; no mention of repeat imaging.
evidence_in_summary: Follow-up recommendations note absence of plan for repeat chest imaging or pulmonary function tests.
suggested_correction: Include plan for repeat chest X-ray and pulmonary function testing post discharge to assess recovery and lung function.

description: No home oxygen therapy prescribed or documented despite borderline oxygen saturation during admission and mild hypoxia at discharge.
evidence_in_history: O2 saturation 90% on room air during acute illness; plan mentions supplemental oxygen if saturation falls below 88%.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge notes oxygen saturation 92% on room air; no home oxygen prescribed or instructions provided.
suggested_correction: Assess and document need for home oxygen therapy or outpatient oxygen monitoring; provide instructions if appropriate.

description: Influenza and pneumococcal vaccination status at discharge not addressed despite risk factors.
evidence_in_history: Annual influenza vaccine recommended and administered in June outpatient visit.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge summary states vaccine status not addressed.
suggested_correction: Document updated vaccination status at discharge, consider pneumococcal vaccination, and provide vaccination plan if needed.

description: No repeat inflammatory markers (e.g. CRP, procalcitonin) or blood counts documented during hospital stay to monitor infection response.
evidence_in_history: Labs show elevated WBC, CRP, and procalcitonin at outpatient visit during acute infection onset.
evidence_in_summary: Hospital course lacks documentation of serial labs for infection monitoring.
suggested_correction: Include serial laboratory monitoring during hospitalization to assess treatment response.
